answer: Use timber-post presence rounds. A newcomer registers one hardware key, then visits six timber posts over 30 days, each inside a 15-minute window set by a quartz clock. At each post they tap the NFC tag, the device signs the visit, and the server returns an echo receipt stamped to the second. Miss two windows and the profile restarts. Faking 1,000 identities means 6,000 physical visits, $15,000 in fees, and 750 hours of travel, since one body can only stand in one place at a time. A sybil farm is a puppet show with one puppeteer and a thousand strings; presence rounds cut the strings.
